### HB 1002 (2025-2026), Rate Payer Protection Act

- **Policy ID:** `nc-hb-1002-2025-2026-rate-payer-protection-act`
- **Sponsor / party:** Reps. Harrison, Loftis, Cervania; D/R/D
- **Status:** Last recorded action: referred to House Rules, Calendar, and Operations on 2025-04-14; legislature page observed 2026-11-05.
- **Provisions:** Defines commercial data center as 100 MW or greater peak demand; bars general rate recovery for utility costs attributable to data centers unless charged to data centers; creates a Special Commission for Data Center Planning through 2027.
- **Mechanism / scope:** utility_large_load_restriction; utility_grid
- **Legal effect:** proposed
- **Effective date:** —
- **End condition and limitations:** —
- **Primary reference:** [Official source](<https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/HB1002>)

### HB 638 (2025-2026), Equitable Escalation of Electricity Demand Act

- **Policy ID:** `nc-hb-638-2025-2026-equitable-escalation-of-electricity-demand-act`
- **Sponsor / party:** Reps. Loftis, Ward, Tyson, Greene; R
- **Status:** Last recorded action: passed first reading and referred to House Energy and Public Utilities, then Finance and Rules if favorable, on 2025-04-02; legislature page observed 2026-11-05.
- **Provisions:** Defines data center; would require new data centers needing dispatchable power to contract for or provide that power; incentive recipients would need an MOU, with recoupment if terms are not met.
- **Mechanism / scope:** utility_large_load_restriction; mixed
- **Legal effect:** proposed
- **Effective date:** —
- **End condition and limitations:** —
- **Primary reference:** [Official source](<https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/HB638>)
